entries.heading: Section 764(d)(3)(B) of division N of Public Law 116-260
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 776. Section 764(d)(3)(B) of division N of Public Law 116-260 
is amended by inserting ``and fiscal year 2022'' 
after ``fiscal year 2021'' and before the final period.
